patch.summary:
Thesis: General-purpose vs specialist — Freshsales documents a broader use-case set; Mailchimp is narrower/specialist.

Frame: General-purpose vs specialist — Freshsales documents a broader use-case set; Mailchimp is narrower/specialist.. Choose Freshsales only if your buying job matches “Freshworks sales CRM for lead management and pipeline workflows.” rather than Mailchimp's shape. Choose Mailchimp only if your buying job matches “Email marketing with CRM features; freemium entry (secondary category: marketing).” rather than Freshsales's shape. Workflow advantage: Freshsales leans pipeline-management, email-outreach; Mailchimp leans contact-management. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: General-purpose vs specialist — Freshsales documents a broader use-case set; Mailchimp is narrower/specialist.
- Positioning: Freshsales is Freshworks sales CRM for lead management and pipeline workflows.; Mailchimp is Email marketing with CRM features; freemium entry (secondary category: marketing)..
- Workflow coverage skew: Freshsales-leaning pipeline-management, email-outreach, outbound-sales vs Mailchimp-leaning contact-management.
- Researched limits: Freshsales — Sales sequences, contact scoring, and territory management start on Pro; forecasting insights, custom modules, sandbox, and audit logs are Enterprise.; Mailchimp — Marketing-led CRM — not a full sales pipeline platform.

Limitations — Freshsales: Sales sequences, contact scoring, and territory management start on Pro; forecasting insights, custom modules, sandbox, and audit logs are Enterprise.; Branded documents ($19/user/mo) and Freddy AI Agent ($49/100 sessions) are listed as paid add-ons.; Mailchimp: Marketing-led CRM — not a full sales pipeline platform; Paid pricing is contact-based and changes — verify live.

Poor-fit cases: Freshsales is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Sales sequences, contact scoring, and territory management start on Pro; forecasting insights, custom modules, sandbox, and audit logs are Enterprise. · Mailchimp is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Marketing-led CRM — not a full sales pipeline platform · Avoid Freshsales if you actually need Mailchimp's motion (Email marketing with CRM features; freemium entry (secondary category: marketing)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
